name: Sunbeam Lethargy
body:
School evocation [light]; Level druid 8, shaman .

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as the spell sunbeam except each time a creature is dealt damage by a beam, they are fatigued. A second time, they are exhausted. The condition cannot be raised past exhausted. If the target is immune to fatigue, they are instead staggered for 1 round if they take damage from the beam. The staggered effect does not stack from multiple hits.
